summary: Round 2 closes most of the Round 1 documentation-discipline issues: W1/W3 are downgraded appropriately, the bad BDCZ equation-number citations are removed, W4 is now explicitly kept at [CONJ], the C1(c)/"签字" overclaims are cleaned up, the test-path typo is fixed, and the concept-map/key-results structure is added. The remaining blocker is substantive: the new W2.5 repair does not mathematically justify the claimed reduction from outcome-dependent Bell-centered swapped states to a single Φ⁺-centered Werner state via Table I’s bit-flip rule, so the core Round 1 critical issue is not actually closed.

issues.description: W2.5 is not sound as stated. The memo equates Table I's classical bit-flip correction with a local Pauli mapping to a common Φ⁺-centered Werner state, but the algebra shown does not establish that. In particular, the memo itself writes `(I⊗X)|Ψ^-⟩ = -|Φ^-⟩`, not `|Φ^+⟩`; so the stated 'bit flip on Bob side' does not map a Ψ⁻-centered Werner state to a Φ⁺-centered one. More importantly, Table I's correction is basis-dependent classical post-processing: a Z-basis bit flip corresponds to `X`, while an X-basis bit flip corresponds to `Z`. That means Table I equalizes measurement correlations, not a single basis-independent post-BSM quantum state. As written, line 231 and W4's premise at lines 267-289 still overstate the repair, so the original outcome-dependent-correction defect remains unresolved at the core reduction step.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite W2.5/W4 around the actual correction model. Either: 1. keep the argument basis-resolved and prove the corrected Z/X correlation statistics directly from the `Ψ^±`-conditioned states; or 2. introduce an explicit outcome-dependent virtual-EB Pauli frame update that really maps `Ψ^+ -> Φ^+` and `Ψ^- -> Φ^+` (for example `X` vs `XZ` on Bob), and then prove that this is the convention being used before invoking W3's `Φ^+`-centered Werner parametrization.

issues.description: The Table I support trail is still internally inconsistent. In W2.5 the background table says the diagonal-basis `|Ψ^+⟩` case is '- (不 flip / 也可能 discard depending on paper text)', but Table I in the PDF is not ambiguous there: it is the exceptional kept/no-flip case. The cited literature note is also not a reliable basis for this section, because `docs/literature/MDI-QKD.md` still summarizes the key map as 'Ψ^- flip; Ψ^+ no flip' without the required basis dependence. That makes line 197's claim that §3.2-§3.3 already made the Table I rule explicit incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Use the PDF Table I directly as the authoritative source and remove the '也可能 discard' hedge. Also fix `docs/literature/MDI-QKD.md` so the rule is basis-conditioned: rectilinear basis flips for both successful `Ψ^-` and `Ψ^+`, while diagonal basis flips only for `Ψ^-` and not for `Ψ^+`.

round_recommendation: Fix W2.5 first: separate basis-dependent classical correction from any virtual-EB Pauli-frame correction, then restate W4 only in terms that follow from that corrected model. After that, align the Table I wording in both the memo and `docs/literature/MDI-QKD.md` before resubmitting Round 3.
